title: No stored value signs anyone in, tokens from before JS-184 included
description: Serves "Joining and signing in are easy and safe."
acceptanceCriteria: On a database that holds tokens issued before JS-184, upgrading to this release hashes them while replicas of the previous release run beside it. No signed-in device is refused through either release during the upgrade or after it, shown with real processes.
Afterwards, every value read from every database table is tried as a token and as a TV-code secret, and every one is refused.
notes: Lands only once a build with JS-184 has replaced every running replica. D-20261127-token-hashing-upgrade.
